hypothesis: Omitting static high-priority preloads for tabiji-art-mask.png and tabiji-paper-plane.png causes WebKit to asynchronously fetch and decode 2048px textures during the first animation frame, causing jank, dropped frames, and visual stuttering in the vector outline path.

When account recovery succeeds, only standalone localStorage keys are removed while Zustand persist cache (tabidachi-trip-storage) remains untouched, allowing stale activeTripId to rehydrate and corrupt new account state.

prevUserIdRef is updated synchronously before SWR trips finish fetching, so when valid trips return and fail to match stale activeTripId, prevUserIdRef === userId evaluates to true, triggering a false-positive 'trip does not exist or access denied' warning toast.
